svg.title: ReuseBind across MSHR merge, fill, and invalidation
svg.desc: The figure traces a typed ReuseBind extension into an MSHR target list, shows the exact conflict rules and newest-sequence rule, applies the selected extension to the downstream fill, validates the destination line at the LLC, and separates this from allocOnFill aggregation.
svg.text: ReuseBind across MSHR merge, fill, and invalidation
MSHR merge validity and FlowThrough allocation are separate state machines.
rebuild state whenever active targets change
allocOnFill = OR(target allocOnFill); independent of ReuseBind validity
conflict never becomes a valid line stamp
serviceable/deferred target changes rebuild merge state; deallocation resets MSHR ECG state
metadata is advisory; data correctness stays architectural
property bytes are never modified by ReuseBind metadata
